about.title: About the Research
about.p1: is an interactive research platform designed to model and analyze political decision-making processes.
about.p2: This study aims to understand how individuals navigate complex policy landscapes when presented with conflicting incentives. The data collected will contribute to ongoing research in the Department of Political Science.
about.note: Your participation helps advance our understanding of democratic systems. All data is anonymized and used solely for academic purposes.

intro.title: Participant Instruction
intro.description: You are about to participate in a simulation driven by an automated agent. Your decisions within this environment will be recorded for analysis. Please ensure you have read the participant information sheet before proceeding.

terms.title: Informed Consent
terms.statement: By clicking "Enter Environment", you acknowledge that:

list.l1: You have voluntarily agreed to participate in this study.
list.l2: You understand that you may withdraw at any time without penalty.
list.l3: Data will be collected on decision times and choices made.
list.l4: No personally identifiable information will be stored publicly.

source.title: Research Data & Source
source.description: Access the codebase and methodology used in this study.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.description: Review the algorithmic framework and decision-making models implemented in the simulation.

academic.title: Academic Use
academic.description: This software is provided for educational and non-commercial research purposes. Please cite the original authors in any derivative works.

splash.subtitle: Choose your path, know thyself
splash.description: Dive into a unique political simulation where you call the shots. Pick a scenario, step into a role, and face real-world dilemmas filled with tough trade-offs and unexpected consequences. Every decision surfaces values, priorities, and perspectives—turning politics into an engaging and educational experience.
